AboutPage.paragraph1: Apostolos Missions International (AM) ni igikorwa gihuza amadini cishimikiye gukwiza ubutumwa bwiza gushika ku mpera z'isi, cishingira urukundo rw'ibihe bidahera rw'Umukama.
AboutPage.paragraph2: (ἀπόστολος) ni ijambo ry'Ikigiriki risobanura intumwa. Risobanura "uwarungitswe mu butumwa" canke "intumwa." Izina "intumwa" rikunda kuboneka mu Isezerano Rishasha rihagararira abigishwa Cumi na Babiri Yezu yatoye (Matayo 10:2, Mariko 3:14, Luka 6:13, Ivyakozwe 2:42). Paulo, uwahoze ahama Ubukirisu hanyuma akaba umuvugizi akomeye w'ubutumwa bwiza, yaravuze ko ari "intumwa" (Abaroma 1:1, 1 Abakorinto 1:1, 2 Abakorinto 1:1, Abagalatiya 1:1, Abakolosayi 1:1, 1 Timoteyo 1:1, 2 Timoteyo 1:1, Tito).
AboutPage.paragraph3: Intumwa ni abarungitswe n'Umukama kugira ngo barangize ubutumwa bwo "kwamamaza Yezu Kristu no kumenyekanisha Imana" ku biremwa vyose. Ishimikiro rya Bibiliya ry'ubutumwa riboneka mu majambo menshi y'Umukama yatoye intumwa za mbere maze akazirungika nk'intumwa zirungitswe guhagararira ibihugu bitandukanye. Intumwa zaratahura ko ubuzima bwazo atari ubwazo gusa, ariko ko zabaho kugira ngo zerekane ubuninahazwa bwa Kristu muri iyi si yaguye.
AboutPage.blockquote: Yohana 20:21 hagira hati, "Yezu yongera kubabwira ati, 'Amahoro abe kuri mwebwe! Nk'uko Data yandungitse, nanje ndabarungika.'" (NIV)
AboutPage.paragraph4: AM ishaka gukurikira umugenzo w'intumwa zabayeho nk'abantu bafise ubutumwa bwo kwamamaza Ijambo ry'Imana. Umwe wese muri twebwe na we arahabwa uwu muhamagaro uva ku Mana wo kurungikwa mw'isi nk'amaboko n'ibirenge vyayo. Turashaka gutanga ubuzima bwacu kugira ngo dukurikire ibirenge vya Yezu tunamamaze Ubutumwa Bwiza gushika ku mpera z'isi.
AboutPage.paragraph5: Nk'uko ubuzima bwacu bwakozweko bugahindurwa n'Umukama, turashaka kwerekana urukundo rw'Umukama rwatweretswe, tukaba umuco ku bana biwe bose bazimiye no ku bavukanyi bacu.

GetInvolvedHub.connectStep1Body: Hariho uburyo bwinshi bwo guhuzwa na AM. Urashobora kwiyandikisha ku rubuga rwacu nyamukuru, www.amintl.org, ugahabwa amakuru. Canke urashobora kwiyandikisha ku rubuga rw'ishure rya Bibiliya rikorera kuri internet, www.amacademy.org, ugahabwa amakuru na porogarama bigezweho. Urashobora kuraba icerekezo cacu, ibikorwa na porogarama vyacu ku mbuga zacu kandi ukatwandikira igihe cose ufise ibibazo.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep2BodySuffix: ng'aha nimba ushaka kuyaga n'umwe mu bakozi bacu ukagirwa impanuro ku rugendo rwawe rw'impwemu. Urashobora gutegura umwanya w'inama canke kuyaga n'abakozi bacu. Benshi mu bakozi bacu bafise uburambe mu buzima bwa kaminuza kandi baratahura ibihe abanyeshure ba kaminuza banyuramwo. Bazogufasha kuronka inzira ibereye urugendo rwawe rw'ukwemera.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodyPrefix: Nimba witeguye gutangura porogarama yacu yo kwiga Bibiliya,
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodySuffix: kuri uru rupapuro. Nimba udaronse ingene bibereye, rungika ifishi y'ubusabe irimwo isomo n'umwanya ukunda!
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep4BodyPrefix: Nimba ushaka guhuzwa n'ibiro vy'ishami ryacu ryo mu karere n'abakozi baryo, ndakwinginze
GetInvolvedHub.growIntro: Nk'uko dukura tugakura tunyuze mu bice bitandukanye vy'ubwana bwacu, turashika ku ntambwe z'ingenzi mu bukuze bwacu bw'impwemu. AM itanga porogarama n'inzira nyinshi vyagenewe kuyobora abanyeshure banyuze muri kimwe kimwe muri ivyo bice bitatu vy'ingenzi vyo gukura mu mpwemu:
GetInvolvedHub.rebornBody: Turavuka ubugira kabiri biciye ku gitambo c'impongano ca Yezu ku Musaraba.
GetInvolvedHub.matureBody: Turakura tukagira ubukuze mu mpwemu biciye ku kugaburirwa urukundo n'ukuri biva kuri Yezu.
GetInvolvedHub.fruitfulBody: Turumva ukwama kw'ubuzima biciye ku mugisha w'Imana, urangizwa mu bumwe bwacu bukuze na Kristu Yezu.
GetInvolvedHub.navigatingBody: Ubuzima bwa kaminuza burahimbaye kandi buranyura, ariko kubera amahitamwo menshi ariho, bushobora no kwumvikana nk'ubudafise icerekezo. Biciye ku kuri no ku gusenga, AM iragufasha gutahura ugushaka kw'Imana no kuronka ubuyobozi butomoye bw'ubuzima bwawe budasanzwe.
GetInvolvedHub.nextStepsBody: Bandanya kwitaba porogarama zacu—koresha uturyo dutandukanye two kwumva Ijambo, gusenga hamwe, kubana n'abavukanyi b'ukwemera, no gukorera igihe ukura mu Butumwa Bwiza.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep1Body: Uko dukura, turipfuza gukorera abandi bakeneye imfashanyo kugira ngo bashike kuri Yezu. Uko dukorera, natwe turakura cane mu rukundo rwa Kristu.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep2Body: Yezu yavuze ati, "Guha ni umuhezagiro kuruta guhabwa" (Ivyakozwe 20:35). Kuyobora no kwerekeza abandi birasaba ubukerebutsi, ugusenga, igitambo, no kwihangana. Ariko, ni ikibanza gihezagiwe aho ubuninahazwa bw'Umusaraba bushika ku mpera.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep3Body: Naho abanyeshure ba kaminuza bakiri bato, ingabirano n'ubuhinga bidasanzwe birashobora kuvumburwa no guteza imbere cane biciye ku bikorwa vy'ubuyobozi. Ni inzira nziza uko umunyeshure wese agerageza kandi agashimangira ingabirano ziwe zo mw'ijuru biciye ku burambe bwuzuye ubuntu bwo gukorera no kuyobora.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep4Body: AM itanga uturyo n'ibikorwa bitandukanye kugira ngo abanyeshure bitabe gukorera no kuyobora. Injira mu mugwi wacu w'abitanga ku bushake, abakozi b'Amashami, abayobozi b'Amashami, abigisha Bibiliya, n'abandi benshi. Menya ico Yezu yateye muri wewe hisunzwe umugambi wiwe mwiza.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph1: Kurangiza kaminuza ni iyindi ntango y'ingenzi yerekeza mw'isi yaguye dushobora gushakisha. Bamwe muri twebwe barashobora kubandanya amasomo canke gukurikira inzira y'akazi. Bamwe muri twebwe na bo baba abakozi ba AM bo mu gihe cuzuye, abamisiyonari, canke abapasitori bakurikira umuhamagaro w'Imana.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph2: Muri iyi ntambwe y'ingenzi, AM itanga porogarama ushobora kubandanya guhuzwa no kubandanya gukorera ubutumwa bw'Ubutumwa Bwiza biciye kuri Alumni Connect. AM itanga na porogarama z'amahugurwa n'inzira zo kuba abakozi b'ubutumwa b'inararibonye n'abakozi muri AM World Mission.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph3: Amahitamwo atandukanye arakwuguruwe yerekeza kw'ejo hazoza heza. AM yipfuza kugendana hafi n'umuntu wese kugira ngo tuzane bose hamwe ku Rutegeko Rukuru, "Nuko mugende muhindure amahanga yose abigishwa, mubabatiza mw'izina rya Data n'iry'Umwana n'iry'Impwemu Yera (Matayo 28:19)."

BibleStudyProgram.heading: Inzira y'ibice 5 uhereye ku kibazo ca mbere ugashika ku kurungikwa.
BibleStudyProgram.description: Porogarama ya AM yo Kwiga Bibiliya y'ibice 5 ni porogarama yo guhindura abigishwa n'inyigisho za Bibiliya bikorwa kuri internet, iyobora abanyeshure banyuze mu nzira ishinze yo kwiga Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Yezu Kristu n'ubuzima bw'ukwemera. Iyi porogarama ihuza abanyeshure n'abigisha Bibiliya bazotanga inyigisho bisunze ingene umwumvirizi ashoboye. Irangira n'akaryo ko kwitanga ku bushake, kwimenyereza kuba umumisiyonari w'umunyeshure, canke gusa kwibiza mw'Ijambo ry'Imana hamwe na AM.
